english.note: Use 流行 when something is widely popular or current, including a style, idea, or philosophy.
Pick this when “current” means popular or prevalent at the moment.

examples.english: Eating plant-based meat is fashionable now.
examples.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 lau4 hang4 sik6 zik6 mat6 juk6

examples.english: This style is very current this year.
